anchors.s1_bullet_ratelimitpolicy: 190-191 (§1: RateLimit-Policy: a quota policy, defined by the server, that client HTTP requests will consume)
anchors.s1_bullet_ratelimit: 193 (§1: RateLimit: the quota currently available under a specific policy)
anchors.s3_ratelimitpolicy_definition: 304-306 (non-empty List[SF] of Quota Policy Items; Item[SF] MUST be String[SF])
anchors.s3_stability_sentence: 308-311 (SHOULD remain consistent over a sequence of HTTP responses; differentiates it from the RateLimit field that MAY change on every request)
anchors.s3_client_flow_sentence: 311-313 (enables clients to control their own flow of requests based on policy information provided by the server)
anchors.s3_dynamic_prefers_ratelimit: 313-317 (highly dynamic throttling better served using the RateLimit field)
anchors.s3_multiple_field_splitting: 319-321 (lists can be split over multiple RateLimit-Policy fields)
anchors.s31_q_parameter: 341-342 (REQUIRED q, quota allocated measured in quota units)
anchors.s31_other_parameters_vendor_prefix: 353-356 (other params allowed 353; service-specific SHOULD be prefixed with a vendor id 355-356)
anchors.s31_trailer_prohibition: 358 (MUST NOT appear in a trailer section)
anchors.s312_quota_unit_parameter: 366-382 (qu MUST be String; registry §10.3; requests / content-bytes / concurrent-requests)
anchors.s313_window_parameter: 397-403 (w MUST be non-negative non-zero Integer seconds, delay-seconds-like)
anchors.s314_partition_key_parameter: 405-410 (pk MUST be Byte Sequence; quotas allocated per partition key)
anchors.s4_definition: 434-439 (current service limit for a quota policy for a particular partition key; List[SF] of Service Limit Items)
anchors.s41_r_parameter: 461-462 (REQUIRED r, available quota under the identified policy)
anchors.s41_t_parameter: 464-467 (OPTIONAL t, effective window: time within which the client can use no more than the available quota)
anchors.s411_available_quota: 477-486 (r non-negative Integer; clients MUST NOT assume availability is a guarantee)
anchors.s412_effective_window: 488-516 (t seconds; server MAY arbitrarily alter available quota and effective window between requests)
anchors.s10_iana: 972-1091 (10.1 field name registry 977, 10.2 problem types 994, 10.3 RateLimit quota unit registry 1041)
